baselineIsolation: Complete git archive; workspace imports resolve within the archive. Only third-party installed dependencies are shared read-only.

protocolNotes.isolation: Fresh child process and independent temporary database for every workload/mode/repetition; alternate mode order. SQLite online backup captures original committed engine contents including WAL. No evidence files copied because entity checks do not read artifacts.
protocolNotes.write: Nine actual state values, one SqliteStore transaction per put; full-engine new run first explicitly migrates three rows per batch, then measures nine same-value updates. Baseline full-engine preserves legacy rows. All entity kinds hash equally before/after migration, writes and reopen.
protocolNotes.read: Cold means first state list after reopening the Store, not a flushed OS disk cache. Fifteen hot get-all and list calls per worker, timing excludes exact-value hash comparisons.
protocolNotes.memory: Node --expose-gc. memoryBeforeReads and memoryAfterReads bracket state reads with forced GC; peak process RSS also includes startup, migration and whole-engine verification. State input values retained equally in both modes. RSS is not a clean cache-only cost.
protocolNotes.storage: Active DB+WAL+SHM immediately after writes, then explicit compact on both modes. Compacted and closed SQLite sizes include entity indexes and Observation tables; no evidence artifact bytes.
protocolNotes.claim: Actual SQLite microbenchmark on this one real OKX snapshot, not a browser run or end-to-end OKX speed claim.
